answer: Require each agent to stake 500 POA locked for 90 days before earning, with a 50% slash for proven sybil behaviour. A farm making 1,000 clones must therefore lock 500,000 tokens, far more than one epoch pays. Detection fires when 20 or more identities share one funding wallet, identical task timing, or one device fingerprint within 24 hours. Like timber stacked on a terrace, every identity needs its own bonded base; a bridge of shared wallets collapses the whole stack when auditors freeze the cluster and slash its stake.
